name: GhostTreeGroup
description: Nested role="group" child container (default <ul>) inside a GhostTreeItem. Registering it makes the item a branch. Reuses GhostCollapsible disclosure mechanics: hidden while collapsed (deferred until the themed height transition ends), aria-labelledby to the item trigger.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the `role="group"` child container.

parts.name: group
parts.description: role="group" child container rendered by GhostTreeGroup.

attributes.name: data-animation
attributes.description: Set when disableAnimation is true; themed height transitions are skipped.

keyboard.Tab: Never a tab stop; navigation is owned by GhostTree.

Tab.title: GhostTree @component:GhostTree › tree/basic: one Tab stop, every documented key, and Axe in both states
